import ast
src = open(sol.__file__).read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
imports = any(isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) for n in ast.walk(tree))
gnl = any(isinstance(n, (ast.Global, ast.Nonlocal)) for n in ast.walk(tree))

snapshot = list(rows)
r1 = sol.summarize_by_category(rows)
r2 = sol.summarize_by_category(rows)
